top_signals.title: Dozens of attacks in Thailand’s restive south leave three wounded
top_signals.summary: Since 2004, a low-level conflict has killed more than 7,000 people as rebels in the Muslim-majority southernmost provinces of Buddhist-majority Thailand battle for more autonomy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
